english.title: Fail to notify TfL of stolen / lost / damage to pedicab vehicle identification
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom means of identification had been issued for a pedicab vehicle to which a London pedicab vehicle licence related, without reasonable excuse, failed to notify TfL within 48 hours in the event of it being stolen, lost or damaged
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(5) and (6) of the Pedicab Vehicles (London)Regulations 2026.
